d:
Sheher ke aakhri kone par bana ek sunsaan bus stop, jahan raat 12 baje ke baad hawa bhi thehar jaati hai.
Jab Aakash ne ek sunsaan road par akele baithi ladki ki madad karne ke liye apni bike roki, toh use andaza bhi nahi tha ki yeh uski zindagi ki sabse badi galti banne waali thi. Purani kaali bus, bench par padi do chotiyaan aur ek aisi rooh jiska badla abhi baaki tha. Madad ki ek pukaar kaise ek behisaab khauf aur cheekh mein badal gayi?
Jaanne ke liye dekhiye yeh khaufnaak daastan.
Watch Sannata on Discovery Channel India.
